name: secureupi-behavioral-risk-v1
target: high-risk payment context (screenshare scam / duress / anomaly)

features.label: Payment amount
features.description: Larger transfers are inherently higher-stakes contexts.

features.label: First payment to payee
features.description: No transaction history with this VPA.

features.label: Amount entry time
features.description: Seconds to key in the amount — slow, hesitant entry is a coercion signal.

features.label: Amount corrections
features.description: Times the amount was edited/deleted while typing (misread instructions?).

features.label: Longest typing pause
features.description: Longest idle gap while entering the amount (waiting for the caller?).

features.label: Review time before Pay
features.description: Time between finishing the amount and pressing Pay.

features.label: PIN entry speed
features.description: Digits of the UPI PIN tapped per second.

features.label: Longest PIN pause
features.description: Longest gap between PIN digits (PIN being dictated?).

features.label: PIN re-entries
features.description: Times the PIN pad was cleared and started again.

features.label: Tap-hold variability
features.description: Std-dev of key-press durations — stress/tremor makes holds uneven.

features.label: Tap accuracy offset
features.description: Avg distance from key centre at press — drops when hands shake.

features.label: Screen-share / remote view
features.description: MediaProjection / accessibility / overlay capture detected during flow.

features.label: Device integrity failure
features.description: Play Integrity verdict failed (rooted, emulator, tampered app).
